text: Nvidia lost its CEO. Five days later, it posted a record quarter.
On November twelfth, Jensen Huang stepped down. CFO Colette Kress took over.
The stock fell over four percent that day.
Her first earnings: one hundred fifteen point eight billion in revenue, up one hundred three percent.
Wall Street expected about one hundred nine. The next-quarter guide: one hundred thirty.
The lesson: key-person risk is not the same as business risk.
The numbers held. The open question is who leads next.
